patch_list: Watch-ad offers grant their reward instantly with no ad. Forced interstitials stay gone.
Removes forced ads. No more ads between levels, no banners.

Never run out of coins, gems or other resources. Buying things never lowers your balance. Note: ignore the coins/diamonds value shown — even if it shows less than the item price, just tap the item and it will be granted.
